issues.summary: Indeterminate checkbox renders as an empty box, same as unchecked; suggests adding a dash glyph and data-indeterminate styling instead
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: checkbox.tsx:42 does hide the only glyph, and the Root has no data-indeterminate styling. But the PR description says outright that an empty box is the intended result ("the box correctly reads as empty"; the test step expects `(1/2)` shown as an **empty box*), and SelectAllToggle.tsx:46-53 shows the (n/m) count and sets aria-checked="mixed". So this is the chosen design, not a defect. F3's request for an explicit statement is already met by the description.

issues.summary: No Storybook story covers the indeterminate checkbox state
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: checkbox.stories.tsx:36-55 shows only unchecked, checked, disabled, and checked+disabled, and AllVariants is tagged `!chromatic`. The new indeterminate styling therefore has no visual coverage. Since the change is one CSS class, the cost of missing a regression here is small.

issues.summary: PR description doesn't mention coordination with any design-system rewrite
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: This is about the PR process, not a code defect. Nothing in the repo shows a conflicting rewrite of apps/web/src/components/ui/, and a one-class change to checkbox.tsx:42 carries negligible merge risk.
